blocks.text: Bain-al-molecular (intermolecular) quwwatein bhi kimiyai bonds ki tarah bandhne wali quwwatein mani jati hain, magar molecules ke darmiyan kashish kimiyai bond se kahin kamzor hai. Yeh quwwatein har qism ke atoms aur molecules ke darmiyan tab maujood mani jati hain jab woh ek doosre ke kaafi qareeb hon, aur van der Waals forces kehlati hain. Yeh molecules ko qareeb lati hain aur gas, maya aur thos halaton mein maddon ko makhsoos tabee khusoosiyat deti hain. Yahan teen qismein bayan hain; tafseeli bahas maddah ki halaton aur phases ke chapter mein hai.

items: Instantaneous dipole-induced dipole forces, ya London dispersion forces.

blocks.prompt: HCl molecules ke darmiyan teen intermolecular forces mein se kaun si mutawaqqa hai, aur argon jaisi noble gas ke molecules ke darmiyan kaun si?
blocks.explanation: HCl molecules mustaqil dipoles hain, to un ke darmiyan permanent dipole-permanent dipole forces kaam karti hain (London forces ke saath). Argon atoms ka koi mustaqil dipole nahi, to sirf instantaneous dipole-induced dipole forces, London dispersion forces, unhen jorti hain.

items: Van der Waals (intermolecular) forces molecules ke darmiyan kamzor bandhne wali quwwatein hain jo gases, liquids aur solids ki tabee khusoosiyat tai karti hain: London dispersion, permanent dipole-dipole aur hydrogen bonding.
